"When will I ever use this in real life?" Here is who uses it, every single day…

🚓

Police

Speed cameras use distance over time.

💍

Jewellers

Density shows if gold is real.

🏗️

Engineers

Pressure decides how big a foundation must be.

🚚

Delivery drivers

Arrival times from distance and speed.

Distance over time. Mass over volume. Force over area.

Hard 1: mixed

Q1

Calculator

[5 marks]

Ria drives 45 km at 60 km/h. She then drives 30 km in 40 minutes. Work out her average speed for the whole journey.

Hint

Answer

Total distance over total time. 60 min = 1 hour.

Answer: 52.9 km/h

click to solve →

Q2

Calculator

[5 marks]

A metal block measures 4 cm by 5 cm by 6 cm. Its mass is 945 g. Densities (g/cm³): aluminium 2.70, zinc 7.13, iron 7.87, copper 8.96. Which metal is the block made from? You must show all your working.

Hint

Answer

Volume first.

Answer: Iron

click to solve →

Q3

Calculator

[6 marks]

Sam weighs 840 N. In boots he stands on 2 soles, each with area 280 cm². On skis he stands on 2 skis, each with area 1400 cm². Snow holds up a pressure of 1 N/cm² without sinking. Show that Sam sinks in boots but not on skis.

Hint

Answer

Find both pressures.

Answer: Boots 1.5 N/cm², skis 0.3 N/cm²

click to solve →
